scope: Cross-setting tests, not a direct replication campaign or a literature replication rate.
mapping_status: Author-coded estimand/fidelity classification; outcome labels mapped from legacy artifacts, with missing-data row withheld.

rows.source_estimand: Continuous language can be reconstructed from fMRI via an LM-guided decoder; prior non-invasive decoders could only identify stimuli from a small closed set.
rows.tested_estimand: Trial-level contrastive retrieval of language features from MEG; not continuous generation

rows.source_estimand: Mid-layer LLM features predict MEG responses better than shallow or deep layers (English MEG, single subject pool).
rows.tested_estimand: Per-(region, LLM, layer) headline-cell scan across 5 cohorts with the full 7-LLM ladder.

rows.source_estimand: Across models, next-word-prediction accuracy correlates with brain score (fMRI/ECoG, sentences); architecture contributes substantially to neural fit.
rows.tested_estimand: Cross-cohort headline z(rho) for 7 LLMs vs random + GloVe + phonemic baselines (LibriBrain, MEG-MASC, MEG-SCANS, Brennan, ECoG).
rows.changed_dimensions: LM-performance correlation -> contextual/static maximum comparison; tensors missing

rows.source_estimand: Augmenting a model's present-word activations with predictions spanning multiple timescales improves the mapping to fMRI responses (304 listeners).
rows.tested_estimand: Word-shift lag analogue on the LibriBrain headline cell: the model word sequence is shifted against the brain (in words) and the peak shift located per post-onset window, GPT-2 and BERT (exp_caucheteux/time_resolved_kpeak_libribrain.tsv).
rows.changed_dimensions: forecast-augmented fMRI encoding -> word-shift MEG alignment

rows.source_estimand: In ECoG high-gamma, deeper LLM layers correspond to later brain activity, strongest in Broca's area (GPT-2 XL, Llama-2).
rows.tested_estimand: Per-(region, LLM, band) layer × peak-time Spearman across 5 cohorts.
rows.changed_dimensions: ECoG high-gamma causal LMs -> multiple bands/cohorts/architectures

rows.source_estimand: Surprisal-related response is stronger within a constituent than across a major boundary (Mandarin MEG; confirmed on English ECoG); the language system does not solely optimize word prediction.
rows.tested_estimand: 5-cohort x 7-LLM x 2-band boundary-conditional RSA; incl. reverse direction with German LLMs.

rows.source_estimand: Shared acoustic-phonetic encoding is language-independent, while word-boundary, word-frequency and language-specific sound-sequence encoding appears only for native language - within the same STG neural populations.
rows.tested_estimand: Layer-split contrast multilingual-BERT vs German-native LLMs across LLM depths on 6-subject MEG-SCANS.

rows.source_estimand: Hadidi et al. (Nat. Commun.): shuffled train-test splits and activation-extraction choices produce spurious alignment; positional signals and word rate fully account for untrained-LLM predictivity. Feghhi et al. (arXiv 2406.01538): a temporal-autocorrelation feature outperforms LLMs; length, position and static word embeddings largely explain trained-LLM brain scores.
rows.tested_estimand: NFCE v1 (3-block) + v2 (6-block: word-rate, position, length, log-freq, lag-1 MEG PCs, chronology) per cohort + per subject.
rows.changed_dimensions: fMRI/ECoG (reading and listening) confound audit -> MEG listening/disaggregation

rows.source_estimand: fMRI encoding performance scales logarithmically with model size, 125M-30B, for unidirectional models (OPT, LLaMA).
rows.tested_estimand: Registered Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B encoding ladder plus the six-point Pythia 70M-2.8B ladder scored per session at the pre-registered depth (scaling_ladder_test_CORRECTED.json); the BERT/GPT-2 raw-RSA comparison is a secondary arm outside their model class.
rows.changed_dimensions: fMRI OPT/LLaMA encoding -> MEG Qwen/Pythia fixed-depth encoding

rows.source_estimand: Iterative residual disentanglement of lexicon, syntax, meaning and reasoning; the isolated reasoning embedding has independent predictive power (one model family, Podcast ECoG).
rows.tested_estimand: Iterative residual disentanglement (lexicon, syntax, meaning, reasoning) on LibriBrain; the reasoning residual split medial versus constituent-onset, read out as alignment per model.
rows.changed_dimensions: one model family -> architecture-dependent boundary contrast
